source.title: fMRI and EEG predictors of dynamic decision parameters during human reinforcement learning

confidence_rationale: Directly evidences MECH-065's non-degeneracy precondition (b): that a commitment threshold can be measured as a live, trial-varying, pre-commit quantity attributable to an identified upstream signal, rather than inferred post hoc from behaviour. Simultaneous fMRI and EEG in healthy adults showed the drift-diffusion decision threshold is NOT fixed across trials but co-varies with STN BOLD and is further modulated by trial-by-trial decision conflict and dorsomedial frontal activity (pre-SMA BOLD, mediofrontal theta). This extends Cavanagh et al. (2011) from a clinical DBS population to healthy subjects and to a trial-resolved measurement. It remains correlational -- no causal manipulation -- and the conflict is again value conflict rather than reality-coherence conflict, which is why confidence sits below the Cavanagh entry despite the cleaner population.
failure_signatures: Threshold modulation was observed specifically when choices differed SUBTLY in reward value. A manipulation that makes the conflicting alternatives grossly unequal may produce no measurable threshold change at all -- so a REE arm that sets an authority/provenance mismatch too coarsely risks a null that reflects manipulation strength rather than absence of the mechanism.

The threshold is identified only jointly with drift rate inside a fitted DDM. If a REE run reports a single scalar 'commitment threshold' without an accompanying drift-rate estimate, a genuine drift effect can masquerade as a threshold effect and satisfy the confirming signature spuriously.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The decision threshold in reward-based choice varies trial by trial rather than being fixed, and that variation is predicted by subthalamic nucleus activity, further modulated by trial-wise decision conflict and dorsomedial frontal cortex activity (pre-SMA BOLD, mediofrontal EEG theta) -- consistent with a pre-SMA-to-STN pathway that adjusts the threshold upward when options differ subtly in value.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-065's non-degeneracy precondition insists that commitment threshold and lock-in pressure must be 'separately measurable at the pre-commit stage, so a shift in them can be attributed to RC_conflict specifically rather than read off final behavioural outcome'. Frank et al. demonstrate that this measurement is achievable in a real system: the threshold is recovered as a trial-varying latent, and its variation is attributed to a specific identified upstream source (STN, modulated by pre-SMA and conflict). For REE this is the measurement template -- a MECH-065 experiment should log the threshold per decision, regress it against the RC_conflict channel trial-by-trial, and report the drift-rate estimate alongside it so a threshold effect cannot be confused with an accumulation-rate effect.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Correlational throughout -- simultaneous fMRI/EEG with model-based regressors, no lesion, stimulation, or pharmacological manipulation, so the pre-SMA-to-STN-to-threshold direction is inferred from the model plus prior anatomy rather than demonstrated causally in this study. The conflict remains subtle-value conflict in a reinforcement-learning task; nothing here involves provenance, authority, or reality-coherence mismatch, so the mapping to MECH-065's specific lane is by analogy to control shape only. The threshold is also not read directly from neural activity but estimated from choice/RT via a DDM with neural regressors, meaning the 'independently readable channel' standard MECH-065 sets for RC_conflict is met on the signal side (STN BOLD, theta) but only approximately on the threshold side.
mapping.source_context: Healthy human adults, simultaneous fMRI and EEG during a probabilistic reinforcement-learning task; hierarchical drift-diffusion modelling with trial-wise neural regressors.

confidence_components.notes: J Neurosci, simultaneous multimodal imaging in healthy subjects, model-based analysis done carefully. The distinctive contribution for MECH-065 is methodological rather than mechanistic -- it shows the pre-commit threshold is measurable trial-by-trial and attributable, which is the precondition the claim itself flags as unmet. Mapping fidelity held below the Cavanagh entry on conflict-content grounds and because this study is correlational.
